Nina thanked Max for the honest advice. Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans. On Friday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. For example, she got a promotion after the big project.

Nina ordered bread and water at the work station last night. Max and Nina are preparing a report about the weekly report. The weekly report looked quieter than usual that evening. Best of all, the lesson ends at noon.
Little by little, things began to change. Max advised Nina to try drawing as a new hobby. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Submit your time sheet each Friday.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The work station has become an important part of daily life. Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, repeated rejections were dispiriting, but she kept submitting poems.
Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
